description: Golden fixtures for the Memory Engine contract layer. Both agents validate against these; a change to any file here is a contract change and requires both sides to re-run their tests. Every fixture file on disk must appear in this manifest and vice versa -- contracts/tests/test_contracts.py enforces that, so a fixture cannot be added without saying what it is for.

expectations.valid: Must validate cleanly against its schema AND satisfy every cross-field invariant.
expectations.schema-invalid: Must be REJECTED by JSON Schema validation. `error_path` names the field the rejection must point at, so a fixture cannot pass the test for an accidental reason. `rejected_by` says whether the rule is type-level (the generated bindings reject it too) or conditional if/then (only jsonschema and the semantic checks can).
expectations.semantic-invalid: Must PASS JSON Schema validation but FAIL a cross-field invariant that JSON Schema cannot express.

fixtures.purpose: A pass report that simply never ran the DPI gate. A pass must be earned, not asserted -- an incomplete checks array would otherwise pass trivially, which is the failure mode where a spec ships because nobody validated it.
exercises: a pass report must contain every hard gate, each passed

fixtures.purpose: A spec cannot count its own failures and still claim a pass. render-print refuses anything but a genuine pass, and there is no override flag.
exercises: if/then constraint forcing error_count to 0 when status is pass

fixtures.purpose: A vendor-valid album: 20 pages, at the vendor minimum and on the increment of 2, passing every hard print gate.
exercises: page count satisfying the vendor profile without the renderer being asked to pad it later
millimetre page geometry with a normalised crop into the source, bridged by effective_dpi
every effective_dpi above the 300 DPI floor at printed size, frame sized from the narrowest source
a pass report containing every hard gate, each passed
spread-level colour harmony solved across facing pages as deltas
enhancement ops carrying license_cleared

fixtures.purpose: JSON Schema cannot compare a clip's source_range against its media_ref's available_range. This fixture is structurally perfect and still unrenderable, which is exactly the class of bug the semantic validator exists to catch before a render starts rather than at 80%.
exercises: clip-01 ends 227 frames past the end of its source

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE required by Phase 0: an EDL with beat-locked cuts and a vertical reframe keyframe track. A 15-second 9:16 Instagram reel cut from the GoPro span assembly at 128 BPM.
exercises: every one of 8 cuts locked to a downbeat, worst alignment error 7.5ms against the 50ms gate
exact NTSC rate 60000/1001 throughout, with fractional beat positions and integer frame positions
8 reframe tracks producing 9:16 from 16:9, SAM 2 subject lock, Savitzky-Golay smoothing, explicit fallback
one dissolve with handles; every other join is a hard cut expressed as the ABSENCE of a transition, per OTIO

a linear_speed time effect on the peak clip: 56 source frames at 0.5x holding 112 timeline frames, which is the one arrangement that distinguishes the two readings of source_range under a speed change (contracts#50) -- and an L-cut on the reaction clip

full audio plan: the music bed placed exactly once, on track a2, with a MusicCue that licenses that clip by id rather than placing a second copy of it (contracts#59); ambient with per-clip gain, an explicit-range ducking rule, and a mix target
a Tier 3 story arc with four acts, five required beats all satisfied, and its ConsentRef
variant metadata, determinism block, and a passing validation report
clip-04 spans the GH01/GH02 chapter boundary at source frame 3067485, proving a cut can cross a chaptered file split via the span assembly
every reframe keyframe uses `smooth`, which is the clamped uniform Catmull-Rom spline the schema states (contracts#51) and the only mode the reel planner emits
an edl_id that recomputes from the plan under the stated canonicalisation, checked rather than asserted

fixtures.purpose: The precision-first invariant is machine-checked, not merely documented. A face whose assignment is auto_below_threshold cannot claim eligibility.
exercises: if/then constraint forcing eligible_for_automated_output to false

fixtures.purpose: An eligible face must name the person it is eligible as. No unexplained permissions.
exercises: if/then constraint requiring person_id when eligible

fixtures.purpose: A consent granted for cloud rendering reused to justify naming a child. Consent is per-scope; a permission for one thing is not a permission for another.
exercises: labeling_consent scope pinned to minor_face_labeling

fixtures.purpose: A confirmed minor named with no consent at all. Detection and counting are always fine; naming is not.
exercises: confirmed_minor requires a labeling_consent object

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE required by Phase 0: a face below the confidence threshold. The model has a guess (0.7418) that it is not permitted to act on against the 0.92 automated-output threshold.
exercises: assignment auto_below_threshold with person_id still null
eligible_for_automated_output false -- precision over recall
two ranked candidates recorded, which is the sibling-confusion case
review_reason below_threshold so the item lands in the review queue rather than in an album

fixtures.purpose: A face a human has confirmed, and therefore the only kind that may appear in unattended output.
exercises: assignment user_confirmed
eligible_for_automated_output true with person_id, confidence and threshold_used all present

fixtures.purpose: A confirmed minor who may be named, because an explicit minor_face_labeling consent exists and is live.
exercises: minor_status confirmed_minor with a correctly scoped, unrevoked consent
eligible_for_automated_output true only because both the identity gate and the minor gate are satisfied
excluded_from_sharing true

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE added for issue #34: the only face fixture with a NON-NULL frame_time, so the half of the face_id encoding that renders a RationalTime is covered by a golden record rather than only by vectors. Its media_id is the GoPro assembly and its track spans the chapter boundary at 3067485, which is the shape moment scoring has to work against.
exercises: frame_time rendered into face_id as value/rate at the NTSC 60000/1001 rate
face_id recomputes under the canonical encoding, in Python and in TypeScript
media_id is the virtual assembly, so a track can cross a chapter boundary
track membership with is_track_representative -- identity is decided once per track
assignment auto_high_confidence, the only eligible state no other fixture covered
detected_on video_proxy_480p, against the member chapter's own proxy

fixtures.purpose: 'No network egress without a consent-ledger entry' is enforced by the contract, not only by code. The CI egress test is the second line of defence; this is the first.
exercises: if/then constraint requiring consent when requires_egress is true

fixtures.purpose: A scan job with paths but no locator digest. This is the collision the review caught: its identity would be indistinguishable from any other scan with the same params.
exercises: scan_source requires source_paths and source_locator_digest

fixtures.purpose: The golden analyze_image job issue #42 asked for, and the one shape the issue named as untestable: killed after image embeddings are stored. Every field is COMPUTED by services/pipeline's own build_job rather than typed, so it describes the job the runner actually creates. It answers the four things the issue said a worker could not freeze -- pipeline selection, model pins, checkpoint semantics and content-addressed output ids.
exercises: job_type analyze_image, with params naming the pipeline and its four steps in order
classical_quality carried as an executor id AND a pinned version, because scores from two versions are not comparable
model_pins in params -- so editing a model config changes job_id and the analysis is redone rather than a stale one reused
inputs.models carrying the same three pins for provenance, weights_blake3 null because nothing in the registry is pinned yet
library_digest = digest_of(sorted media ids of the six analysable media fixtures)

checkpoint.completed_input_ids DELIBERATELY EMPTY: completion is per record in MediaRecord.processing.stages, because rewriting a 300,000-element array per image is quadratic and gives a second answer that can disagree with the records
an opaque cursor naming the step and the last media id, which is the coarse half of resumption
outputs as content addresses -- a MediaRecord id and a FaceRecord id that both exist in this fixture set
job_id and params_digest recompute under the encodings the schema states

fixtures.purpose: A scan of one drive. Half of the pair proving scan identity is per-source-root.
exercises: source_locator_digest over the canonicalised roots
units_total null while the walk is still discovering, so the progress bar cannot lie
an opaque resumable walk cursor

fixtures.purpose: A scan of a DIFFERENT drive with identical params, scope and (empty) media ids. Its job_id differs only because of the source-locator digest; without that field these two would collide and the second drive would silently never be imported.
exercises: distinct source_locator_digest yielding a distinct job_id
identical params_digest and scope, proving the digest is what separates them

fixtures.purpose: The only kind of job permitted to touch the network: a Tier 3 contact-sheet request with a consent-ledger entry.
exercises: requires_egress true with consent, destination and payload_kind all present
payload_kind contact_sheet -- thumbnails only, never originals
a journal recording the consent and both network legs

fixtures.purpose: The resumption case: a proxy job killed mid-run and picked back up, having already finished chapter 1.
exercises: an opaque worker-owned checkpoint cursor
completed_input_ids so a resume does not redo finished work
partial_output_ids so the chapter-1 proxy is neither orphaned nor regenerated
progress in real units (frames) with a stale heartbeat telling the scheduler the job was killed, not hung
a retryable error retained on attempt 1 while attempt 2 runs

fixtures.purpose: The identity conflict raised in review: an assembly claiming a byte size it does not have and exposing a member's path as its own. A size matching no file on disk breaks anything that verifies a record against the filesystem.
exercises: conditional validation on asset_kind virtual_assembly

fixtures.purpose: A hash declaring 256 bits while carrying 16 hex characters. Left unchecked, Hamming distance against a truncated digest is meaningless and silently merges unrelated photos.
exercises: bits/hex length agreement enforced by if/then

fixtures.purpose: additionalProperties:false must reject an invented field. This is the guard that stops either agent quietly extending a record instead of changing the contract.
exercises: rejection of the undeclared field `rating_out_of_ten`

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE: a truncated file from a recovered drive. It hashes fine and decodes to nothing, and the record exists precisely so the failure is visible rather than silent.
exercises: processing state quarantined, so it is never retried automatically
per-stage failures with a redacted, non-retryable file_corrupt error
perceptual_hash skipped with a reason -- hashing a partial decode would poison dedupe buckets
excluded_from_automation with reason 'corrupt'

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE: a zero-byte file. Also shows content-addressing doing its job at the extreme: every empty file on the drive collapses into this one record with several paths.
exercises: byte_size 0 on a physical_file, which is legal
two sources on one record, because all empty files share a content hash
zero_byte_file error, non-retryable
thumbnail skipped before any decode was attempted

fixtures.purpose: The realistic baseline: a well-exposed DSLR photo with full EXIF, GPS, two source locations for the same bytes (drive plus Google Takeout), a dedupe group where it is primary, and a complete analysis pass.
exercises: content-addressed dedupe across two import paths
full model_runs provenance
confirmed person present

fixtures.purpose: HEIC from an iCloud export, saved with a .JPG extension. Format is detected from content, never from the extension -- trusting the extension here would hand a HEIC to a JPEG decoder.
exercises: file_format heic while the path ends .JPG
orientation 6, with stored_size and oriented_size swapped accordingly
Display P3 with 10-bit depth and is_hdr true
a 256-bit perceptual hash with the matching 64 hex characters

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE: a record written before phash-dct-64-v2 replaced phash-dct-64 (issue #14). It exists so that removing the superseded algorithm from the enum breaks a test rather than a library: everything scanned before the change still validates, and must.
exercises: algorithm phash-dct-64, which no current writer emits and which must never be compared against a v2 digest
a legacy digest with its top bit set -- the constant DC bit that the change removed
processing.state proxied with no analysis stages, i.e. a record the analysis pass has not reached

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE: a photo with genuinely no recoverable date. A flatbed scan of a print -- no EXIF, and nothing in the filename to infer from either, which is what separates it from the WhatsApp fixture.
exercises: captured_at present but wholly empty rather than absent
source 'unknown' with confidence 0.0 and precision 'unknown'
chronological output must exclude it rather than sort it to the epoch
metadata_present is an empty array, which is normal and not an error

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE: the WhatsApp adapter recovering a date from the filename convention when the file has no EXIF at all. Distinct from the undated fixture: here a date IS recoverable, just weakly.
exercises: source filename_pattern parsed from IMG-20230812-WA0037.jpg
precision 'day' rather than 'second' -- the filename carries no clock time
confidence 0.72, so event clustering weights it below an EXIF original
local set with utc and timezone still null, because a filename implies no zone

fixtures.purpose: The motion half of the same Live Photo. The pairing is bidirectional so either file can be found from the other.
exercises: kind motion_photo with a 3-second 30fps track
paired_motion_media_id pointing back at the still
is_variable_frame_rate true with a 'table' frame-index mapping, the real phone-video case
shot detection skipped with a reason rather than silently

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE: the still half of a Live Photo, which arrives from an iCloud export as two unrelated files that must be re-paired.
exercises: kind live_photo
paired_motion_media_id pointing at the motion record
the .MOV listed as a sidecar_path so the pairing survives a re-scan
video_proxy not_applicable with a stated reason: the motion track is its own record

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE required by Phase 0, part 1 of 3: the first physical file of a GoPro chaptered recording.
exercises: span.role = member with index 0 and offset_in_span 0
exact NTSC frame rate 60000/1001 preserved as a rational
video proxy carrying a frame-index sidecar
shot detection deliberately skipped with a stated skip_reason, because analysis runs on the assembly

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE part 2 of 3: the second chapter, offset into the recording by the first chapter's duration.
exercises: span index 1
offset_in_span 42405 frames
continuity verified_gapless

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE part 3 of 3: the virtual assembly representing both chapters as one continuous recording. This is the id MomentRecords and EDL clips reference, so a cut can cross a chapter boundary without any planner knowing chapters exist.
exercises: asset_kind virtual_assembly, with the conditional identity rules that implies
media_id equals span_id -- no bytes to hash, so its members' identity is its identity
byte_size 0, no sources and no proxies: the members own all three
duration equals the sum of member durations (42405 + 19188 = 61593)

fixtures.purpose: EDGE CASE: a moment straddling the GH01/GH02 chapter boundary. It addresses the span assembly, so the boundary is invisible to scoring and to the planner.
exercises: source_range [3067380, 3067620) spanning the boundary at 3067485
media_id is the assembly, never a member
snap points on both sides of the file split

fixtures.purpose: Elimination is first-class. This record exists only to say 'rejected, and here is why', which on a real action-camera library is the outcome for 90-95% of footage.
exercises: eliminated true with three reasons at the free `classical` stage
no snap points and no safe_trim, because nothing downstream may use it

fixtures.purpose: A keepworthy moment scored by a Tier 3 pass: laughter, a confirmed person, speech with word-level timing, and five certified snap points.
exercises: source_range in source timecode alongside proxy_range in proxy time
snap points with asymmetric cut_direction (a motion onset is an in-point, not an out-point)
speech_safe_in / speech_safe_out derived from word timestamps -- the no-mid-word-cut mechanism
preserve_audio_tail true, which the EDL realises as an L-cut

fixtures.purpose: The privacy promise expressed as a type. A PrefEvent carrying pixel data is structurally invalid, not merely discouraged.
exercises: const false on pixel_data_present

fixtures.purpose: An event still holding local identifiers cannot be queued for the global training pool, even with consent. The schema blocks it so a bug elsewhere cannot leak it.
exercises: if/then constraint requiring contains_local_identifiers false and an anonymization_version when shareable

fixtures.purpose: A re-crop, which is the strongest signal of all: the human has not merely judged, they have demonstrated the correct answer. Shown here in its exportable, anonymised form.
exercises: crop_before / crop_after as the label
shareable_for_global_model true, with consent, anonymization_version set and person_ids stripped
pixel_data_present false -- feature vectors and decisions only

fixtures.purpose: The richest preference signal the system gets: the user picked the rank-1 variant over the rank-0 variant the model scored higher. That disagreement is the error signal.
exercises: all three alternatives carried with their presented rank, presented score and feature vector -- the pairwise comparison, not just the outcome
named features alongside a dense vector, both pinned to feature_set_id
scores frozen as presented, never recomputed
deliberation time recorded as evidence strength
local-only: person ids present, so shareable_for_global_model is false

fixtures.purpose: A manifest claiming the publication is cleared while its own item counts say one item is indeterminate. The aggregate must never be able to contradict the items it summarises: a verifier that trusted the summary would publish the unchecked photo.

THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT RULE IN THE CONTRACT. Somebody tries to override an item nobody classified. 'Nobody checked' and 'somebody checked and disagreed' are different states and only the second is a decision -- so a missing verdict cannot be waved through by a flag, a default, or a well-meaning human. Enforced in the schema rather than only in code, because one caller passing an override would otherwise silently reopen the hole.

THE CASE THE DESIGN EXISTS FOR. The classifier could not be loaded, so one item has no verdict, and the publication is denied. A VALID manifest that DENIES -- the distinction matters, because the failure this prevents is a check that silently no-ops when its model is missing and lets everything downstream read the absence as a pass. Note the sink is frontier_egress, the one path where imagery leaves the device and the only irreversible one.
The ordinary case: every item cleared, so the book may be printed. Here mainly so the two rejections below are not the only shapes anyone reads.

A parent overriding a positive result on a breastfeeding photo scored medical_or_artistic. The classifier does not get a veto over a family's judgement about their own photographs; the override is attributable and scoped to this item and this sink only.
